title: first
description: A command-line tool for segmenting subcortical structures in MRI images using models and transformations.

input_file.description: Filename of input image to be segmented.
input_file.title: Input image file

input_model.description: Filename of input model (the structure to be segmented).
input_model.title: Input model file

flirt_matrix.description: Filename of flirt matrix that transform input image to MNI space (output of first_flirt).
flirt_matrix.title: Flirt matrix file

input_model2.description: Filename of second input model (the structure to be segmented).
input_model2.title: Second input model file

intref.description: Use structure specified by modelname2 as intensity reference
intref.title: Intensity reference flag

multi_image_input.description: Use structure specified by modelname2 as intensity reference
multi_image_input.title: Multi-image input flag

binary_surface_output.description: Use structure specified by modelname2 as intensity reference
binary_surface_output.title: Binary surface output flag

bvars.description: Initialize using bvars from a previous segmentation. When using with --shcond specifies the shape of the structure we are conditioning on.
bvars.title: Bvars file

loadbvars.description: Load initial parameter estimates from a previous segmentation.
loadbvars.title: Load bvars flag
